answers.host_quote: Pete Hexeth will be the Secretary of Defense slash war by the end of January. Yes or no? When the end of January comes, I should say. Yes or no?
answers.resolution_criteria: Pete Hegseth holds the office of Secretary of Defense (also styled Secretary of War) on January 31, 2027. YES means he holds it; an announced but not yet effective departure still counts as holding. Resignation, dismissal or any other departure before that date means NO. Decided by the responsible body's own published record (an official announcement, filing, vote, opinion or data release). Resolves when the answer is a matter of record; the deadline is 2027-01-31.

answers.question: Will China make an aggressive move against Taiwan before Trump's second term ends (January 20, 2029)
answers.quote: So I think it's probably about 15 percent.
answers.turn_text: Well, I think it's higher than that. I don't I don't I don't fundamentally disagree. I don't think it's imminent. I think if you if you pay even reasonably close attention to, like, the China watchers and people who study the PLA and and and Xi and the CCP internally at a granular level. It is true. I think that Xi would would very much rather not take Taiwan by force. It's not just a risk minimization position. I actually think it's a legacy position for him. And again, to the extent this is criminology, it's it's Beijingology or Pekingology or whatever. And so we can't really know. But everything I've read about his personal disposition on this question is that he'd rather not do it violently. And I think that is might come as a surprise to some people who are who look at it, you know, more from a more casual distance. But I do think it's probably the better, better theory. The problem, I think, is and this could be the real damaging thing that comes out of out of the Xi visit from the Trump side is if you move off of strategic ambiguity on Taiwan and you do something like you stop sending them arms or you affirm that you oppose their independence, that changes Xi's calculus so radically that the percentage goes from maybe a five percent to maybe as high as a as a as a 20 percent. And the last little bit of thing I'll say, though, is that it does seem also like, you know, a lot of people in the in the in the circles talk about 2027, a goal that Xi set for the PLA and the PLAN to be ready for a move on Taiwan. I think people are starting to see that number now, that year as a and that deadline is kind of more part of his exercise to kind of purge the widespread corruption that runs through the Chinese military and and just sort of force it to modernize under his brutal iron fist. As opposed to that, I don't think anyone really inside that world thinks about 2027 that way anymore. So I think it's probably about 15 percent.
answers.host_quote: So I ask the question to you first. MBD percentage odds that there'll be some aggressive Chinese move against Taiwan before Donald Trump's second term is out.
answers.resolution_criteria: Between the air date and noon ET on January 20, 2029, the People's Republic of China takes an aggressive military or coercive action against Taiwan beyond routine exercises and incursions: a blockade or quarantine, seizure of Taiwan-held territory such as an outlying island, a kinetic strike, or an invasion. Decided by the Associated Press or Reuters reporting that it has happened. Resolves YES as soon as the event is recorded as having happened on or before 2029-01-20; otherwise NO on 2029-01-20.
